steps.content: Amidst the fierce fight, Donald slashes open the knight's armor. The current seizes the chance to infiltrate Paradeisos's tech piece, but the enemy swiftly rips off their arm armor and tosses it aside, baring their arm. In Donald's eyes, there is a peculiar strangeness to this action.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Hmm? That knight is...?

Just as he is trying to make sense of the eerie sensation, a bunch of Rustfire Corruptors burst forth, latching onto Donald's feet. Instantly, Paradeisos's fighter breaks free from Donald and bolts towards ${PlayerName}. The knight's focus on the target is unwavering throughout.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Dodge now!!!

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Catch him!
There's no escape—the warrior clad in white bolts towards you. A surge of mighty force echoes with the surrounding Mania, tipping you off to this person's oddity.
...A Sinner?
The fighter stays silent, charging at you with wounds all over and gripping your neck. You don't have time to struggle, so you let them proceed.
—But you've eyed their exposed arm reaching out to you. Being a Sinner, this gives you a shot at a countermove.
[Release the shackles]
Shackles wrapped in a dark aura instantly subdue your attacker. Donald swoops in, forcing them back, and both sides swiftly part ways, distancing themselves.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: You okay?
There's something off with your shackles. That person is surely a Sinner, but not like any other. Could it be the shackles' corruption causing this sensory skew? Or is the target not quite right?
I'm okay... but that Paradeisian...

Paradeisos's fighter is down on one knee, gasping for air. The corrupted shackles are clearly putting a strain on them. They pull out a Hypercube, struggling to hold it back, but the mechanical command-giver doesn't seem pleased.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Are these shackles sapping your strength to fight? What a blunder—never should've touched the SHP directly with your skin.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: No stepping back, capture him. You're a special Sinner, shackles can't hold you down easily, and they're weakened now.
steps.female_content: No stepping back, capture her. You're an extraordinary Sinner, shackles can't hold you down easily, and they're weakened now.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Take control of SHP-13; it's high time—zzzz—zzzz—

Signal interference halts the mechanical voice mid-sentence, pausing the onslaught. Schorl settles into silence, its light ebbing smoothly. It might sound odd, but it's as if it's become someone entirely different.
There was no need for that clash. Let's try a different tack, with someone new, and begin the conversation again.
Hello, Chief ${PlayerName}. I operate the EDGE-01 super-loop Communication Channel and am part of Paradeisos's decision-making team.

steps.speaker: EDGE-01
steps.content: We're both facing significant pressure. Fighting here is just wasting time and wearing each other down. In the end, it's the Black Ring and the Underground who'll gain from this, hurting our city-state.

steps.speaker: EDGE-01
steps.content: So, I'm committing to stop any offensive moves against you and I'm looking for a frank discussion. We're in need of your insight and support.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: ...Don't get pulled into their game.

steps.speaker: EDGE-01
steps.content: Appreciate your understanding. Let's skip the past mix-ups and cut to the chase as time's ticking.
Oddly enough, you don't hear a soul, but these messages infiltrate your thoughts, instantly making sense.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Let's skip the formalities about where we stand. In this fight against Mania, we're both enemies to the Underground.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Fueled by their instigations, BR-002's grown incredibly volatile. The radiation's engulfed 80% of the West District and is creeping towards Eastside.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: We've got 48 hours before everyone's turned, feeding into BR-002's Mania. Beyond that, it becomes unstoppable.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: This is our last shot. We need to cut it down or wipe it out before time's up. Our best bet is the local Purge Order.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Normally, Rules can't breach the Black Ring's effect on those Corpsebornes. But you're a game changer.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Your clashes with Corpus 002 have linked you to it by shackles. Once you accept the Rules and anchor yourself, we can slice through the Black Ring. We're talking about a perfect sync—a direct, pinpoint strike on Corpus 002.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: It's a plan with solid backing. Nirvana's on board too, pledging a decade's worth of Hypercube yield to fuel our strategy.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: We'll pause all operations linked to the Purge Order. And we'll wipe out BR-002's threat to the West District, for good.

options: If it was a walk in the park,

steps.content: you wouldn't be tossing the decision my way.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: That's right. As the bearer of the Rules, you'll be completely destroyed at a 100% sync rate, leaving no chance of survival. 
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: And to make sure you don't bite the dust before Corpus 002, we need a one-hit knockout at a full sync.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: That's the full briefing.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Now, what do you choose?
This is moral blackmail! You're pressuring me to end it all with millions of lives at stake?

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Feeling weighed down by the morality of this choice? That just proves X's point—you're a genuinely good and honest person.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Matches up with everything your actions have shown so far.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Don't worry, I'm not about to force your hand. The way things have panned out, no matter what we choose, we've already hit rock bottom as representatives of humanity.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: However, if I were calling the shots, I'd save you in a heartbeat and go ahead with the Purge Order.

options: ...Stop, this is just making me sick.

steps.content: <color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: I figured you'd think that.

<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: The Purge Order could work. But pushing it too hard, considering how you are, would mean losing your trust for good. It'd also take a heavy toll on your strong mental resilience.
<color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: In that case, everything I've sacrificed to keep you safe would be for nothing.
You hesitate, momentarily caught off guard, then chuckle at the sheer absurdity.

options: Am I that important to Paradeisos?

steps.content: <color=#fb9259>EDGE-01</color>: Everyone's perspective varies. On this issue, I can't speak on behalf of Paradeisos.

The High Tower shakes more violently, and the skirmishes below rage on with increasing ferocity. The flow of information between you two also grows increasingly erratic, and one brief distraction leads to your abrupt exit from the previous channel.

steps.speaker: EDGE-01
steps.content: After losing the Second Observatorium, maintaining a stable super-loop communication with BR-002 became a daunting task, and time is running out rapidly. I'm also dealing with enemies that demand my full concentration.

steps.speaker: EDGE-01
steps.content: Regarding BR-002, no matter which option you decide on, the situation can move forward as far as I'm concerned. But for you, it's a matter of life and death.

steps.speaker: EDGE-01
steps.content: That's why I'm leaving the choice in your hands, along with Schorl. Its attack modules are now permanently disabled for you, providing only the "Rules" interface and limited security protection.

steps.speaker: EDGE-01
steps.content: In 27 hours outside the Ring, Paradeisos will promptly enact the Purge Order. This will eradicate all residents in the West District, thwarting their efforts to further strengthen BR-002.

steps.speaker: EDGE-01
steps.content: Before then, you and your friends can do your best to organize a mass exodus, though your efforts may only save a few. The West District is doomed, with millions destined to be erased. If this burden is too much for you to handle...

steps.speaker: EDGE-01
steps.content: Until that time comes, there's an alternative.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: That's enough; he doesn't have to follow the paths you're laying out for him.
steps.female_content: That's enough; she doesn't have to follow the paths you're laying out for her.

steps.content: He pulls you away. The vibrations from below intensify, steadily picking up pace as if in pursuit of something. Yet, Donald stands steadfast.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Nine long years... and you all haven't changed a bit, still pulling the same stunts. We've got our own mission, our own questions to unravel.

steps.speaker: Donald
steps.content: Those who've never bothered to see us eye to eye have no business bossing us around here!

A sudden, powerful jolt, and chunks of iron pillars fall from the heights, narrowly missing the ground where you stand. At the same time, pollution erupts from below, rushing upwards like a volcanic explosion, rapidly swallowing everything in its path.
In a flash of electricity, Donald deploys a grappling hook, whisking you away from the collapsing floor.
